rule.title: External, confirmatory validation of the locked APNet recipe on Shin et al. (2018) dataset A (n-back)
rule.status: confirmatory: APNet was locked on 12 Oct 2026 (v4_lock.json); nothing is tuned on this dataset

data.preprocessing: EEG channels, flat channels (< 0.5 uV SD) interpolated, 1-40 Hz, 250 Hz, average reference, 3 s excluded at the task start, 4-s windows / 2-s step, windows > 500 uV peak-to-peak rejected

rule.folds: LOSO over all participants; 4 validation participants per fold (seeded rotation, as COG-BCI); test participant never used for choices

models.eegnet: EEGNet, FINAL protocol (training-fold z-score, early stopping 30/6 on validation, argmax)
models.d_tricks: EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] (APNet pipeline without APNet's components)
models.apnet: APNet = locked d_v3_ls: EEGNet + IG-TCAI (gamma 0.3 x (1 - TLCI); one task -> TLCI 0) + within-level ranking 0.5 + label smoothing 0.1, EA, SWA 20/8, AdaBN per subject
models.f_cbra_probe: CBraMod linear probe under APNet's protocol

rule.seeds: seed 0 for every model (primary); seeds 1000 and 2000 for apnet and d_tricks (secondary, 3-seed ensembles)
rule.score_option: SWA models: none / subject-wise centring chosen per model on validation subjects; EEGNet (FINAL protocol): argmax

tests.H-E1 (primary): APNet (seed 0) > EEGNet (seed 0): one-sided Wilcoxon over held-out participants, alpha 0.05
tests.H-E3: APNet (seed 0) vs each recent model under APNet's protocol: two-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over 4
tests.H-E4: APNet (3-seed) vs EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] (3-seed): two-sided Wilcoxon (are APNet's components useful here?)
tests.reporting: every test is reported whatever its outcome; no model, setting or test is added after this file is saved
